newsitem.title: USA: Coltec stake held by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Coltec stake held by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment advisor Mario Gabelli said on Thursday it holds a 5.10 percent stake in Coltec Industries Inc or 3,547,600 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net of 530,400 common shares bought between August 19 and October 22 at prices ranging from $13.9578 to $17.75 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
Coltec is a diversified manufacturing company serving primarily aerospace and government industrial markets.
